birthDate.note: Info.fr states he was born 12 juillet 2002 in Sèvres. No official profile fetched gives the date; the ATP and Australian Open pages show age only. Verify against ATP if it becomes available.

birthPlace.note: ATP bio: 'Born in Sèvres, France.' Info.fr adds Hauts-de-Seine. The tennis-db profile field shows Wimbledon, England, which refers to residence, not birth.

nationality.note: Info.fr says he holds French and British nationality. Australian Open lists United Kingdom as country; ATP and LTA say he represents Great Britain. The Connexion calls him a Franco-British player who feels British and was born in Sèvres.

gapNote: Most press repeats '23-year-old' and a mix of rankings (114 entering Wimbledon, career high 33 or 36 depending on source), and some sites misplace the Wimbledon rounds. The page can give the verified sequence: round of 16 win over Grigor Dimitrov, quarter-final win over Flavio Cobolli, semi-final loss to Alexander Zverev 7-6(0), 6-2, 6-4 (LTA), and his age from the 12 July 2002 date. Sources conflict on career-high ranking, so the page should state the date and source of any ranking it cites or leave it out.
